archetypes.name: dyn-ship-merge-loop
archetypes.rationale: The change alters CI-not-ready routing in the ship merge loop.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed ship merge loop behavior around MERGE_RESULT_CI_NOT_READY. Verify admin fallback skips reviewDecision and re-enters the CI wait path, while --no-admin-fallback still bails only on REVIEW_REQUIRED. Check that diagnostic merge-state reads cannot mask the intended handoff. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
